extra.reason: Decided without the spike: build our own AST from scratch matching TypeScript's shape. oxc_ast is deliberately ESTree-flavored (Identifier split into BindingIdentifier/IdentifierReference/IdentifierName per their ARCHITECTURE.md), and tsgo's 60k-LOC checker, 39k-LOC language service and all 49,354 baselines are written against TS's AST shape. Take oxc as inspiration, not dependency. See PLAN.md section 8.

Cargo workspace (edition 2024, resolver 3), workspace lints with clippy::pedantic, rustfmt.toml, and GitHub Actions CI running fmt/clippy -D warnings/test plus a codegen-freshness gate that regenerates and diffs the checked-in output.

xtask codegen implemented against vendor/typescript-go/_scripts/ast.json — upstream's own schema-validated AST definition, which is a far better source than re-deriving from _submodules/TypeScript. Generates SyntaxKind (351 kinds + markers + range predicates), 192 node structs, 72 alias union enums, and the Visit trait with walk_* functions. Diagnostics catalogue codegen remains outstanding; filed separately.

Diagnostics catalogue generated from diagnosticMessages.json + extraDiagnosticMessages.json into crates/tsr-diagnostics: 2,162 messages with codes, categories, localization keys, and flags, plus positional {n} formatting. Conformance asserts against internal/diagnostics/diagnostics_generated.go (2,154 messages) and quantifies our deliberate 8-message superset. Localization (13 locales) is separate: tsr-5e7.6.

Parser compiles and is back in the workspace. parser_typescript went 0% -> 70.27% (3969/5648). Root cause of the delay was constructor signatures changing under it when node nullability was corrected; all reconciled. 41 unit tests, clippy clean under -D warnings.
